title: LiGre Lemma Bank: a Lemma Bank for Ancient Greek as Linked Open Data
description:
LiGre, the Lemma Bank for Ancient Greek, publishes about 100,000 Ancient Greek lemmas as linked open data. Each lemma is an instance of the LiLa Lemma class with its written representations (OntoLex-Lemon), part of speech and, for nouns, gender, so that Ancient Greek corpora and lexical resources can be linked through their lemmas, following the conventions of the LiLa Knowledge Base for Latin. The lemmas are published as in the lemma list compiled by Swaelens, Mambrini and Passarotti (2026), without corrections.

This archive is a snapshot of the GitHub repository at the release tag. The data dump is ttl/ligre_lemmabank.ttl; its VoID/DCAT description, with statistics, is ttl/lemmabank_void.ttl, and the description of the whole LiGre Knowledge Base is ttl/ligre_void.ttl. The archive also contains the source tables, the Postgres schema, the Ontop (R2RML) mapping, the Docker setup to run the SPARQL endpoint locally, and example SPARQL queries in queries/.

Live services: lemma IRIs under https://w3id.org/ligre/data/id/, SPARQL endpoint https://ligre.ugent.be/sparql, knowledge base description at https://ligre-lod.github.io/.well-known/void.
